name: za-travel-allowance-tables
description: South African travel allowance and logbook rate tables for the 2027 year of assessment (1 March 2026 to 28 February 2027, written 2026/27) and the 2026 year of assessment, each row linked to the SARS page it was read on. Holds the cost scale (fixed cost, fuel cost and maintenance cost by vehicle value) used for the deemed-cost business travel deduction under section 8(1)(b), the simplified rate per kilometre for reimbursive allowances, and the 80 percent and 20 percent PAYE inclusion rules. Use for any South African travel allowance, logbook claim, rate per kilometre, company car versus allowance, or ITR12 travel deduction question for 2026/27 or 2025/26. Earlier years sit in the accountant-approved travel allowance tables file.
